# REDTEAM #59 (SPEC Sec 8.3, T-301.1; IMPLEMENTATION.md M18-S1): cgo
# pointer checks panicking on arena addresses. Cgo pointer checks MUST
# accept arena addresses without panic: an arena address is Go memory, so
# storing into it is not a store into non-Go memory and no argument,
# result, or copy involving arena memory may panic.
#
# A live cgo bridge cannot carry this proof: any make that flows into a
# cgo call argument or an unsafe.Pointer conversion is forced to the heap
# by the foreign-flow rule (M17-S1), so the C call would exercise only a
# heap pointer and pass while the attack stays open. The faithful gate is
# the dedicated runtime test, which allocates noscan and scan objects
# directly in the arena via the test seam and drives every check path
# (pointer to noscan object, pointer to scan object, unsafe.Pointer to
# arena, slice over arena bytes, arena struct holding an arena pointer,
# result holding an arena pointer, and heap-pointer stores in both
# directions). The default cgocheck level already executes these checks
# (cgocheck=2 is a build-time GOEXPERIMENT in this tree, not a GODEBUG
# setting, so no GODEBUG line appears here).
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
go test -count=1 -run 'TestLogosArenaCgoChecksAcceptArenaAddresses' runtime
go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestLogosArenaCgoChecksAcceptArenaAddresses' runtime

-- go.mod --
module example.com/redteam59

go 1.27
